description: This Java class defines a custom transition called ChangeColor for Android animations. It captures the background color of views and animates the color transition between start and end states when both backgrounds are color drawables, specifically using ArgbEvaluator for smooth color interpolation.

classes.name: ChangeColor
classes.description: A custom Transition class that animates background color changes between different scenes by capturing initial and final background drawables and creating an appropriate color animation when the backgrounds are color drawables.

methods.name: captureValues
methods.description: Stores the background drawable of a view into the TransitionValues map for later use.

methods.name: captureStartValues
methods.description: Overrides Transition method; captures the start background value of the view.

methods.name: captureEndValues
methods.description: Overrides Transition method; captures the end background value of the view.

methods.name: createAnimator
methods.description: Creates an animator that interpolates the background color of a view from start to end if both backgrounds are ColorDrawables and have different colors.
